# Trading Direkt 2026-11-20 | Bornold om Anthropics rekord IPO, Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-11-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode opens with guest Joakim Bornold (Levler) on Anthropic's record IPO. He sees AI as a real industrial revolution but doubts Anthropic will be the big winner, and he prefers Sweden, value stocks, industrials, banks, small caps and contrarian real estate ahead of a strong 2027 (he guesses +25%). Tobbe Rosén's technical analysis is cautious. Indices are oversold near their MA200 and VIX is high, so he expects any rebounds to be short. He then gives single-stock setups: positive on Embracer, Addnode, Bure, SKF and Instalco, negative on Intel, Soltech and Hinex. The closing news update covers a broad AI-led sell-off and several analyst rating changes.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EMBRAC-B — Embracer | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Tobbe's medium-term pick from a strength-breeds-strength screen, pulling back to an attractive entry.

#### Reasoning

Host TA (Tobbe Rosén): a clean rising trend with a pullback to an interesting level. A strong close above the prior day's high would give good conditions for strength over the next three months.

#### Sell Triggers

- no strong close above prior day's high
- break of the uptrend
- broad market collapse

> *"så är det goda förutsättningar för att Embracer kommer gå starkt även de kommande tre månaderna"*

### 🟢 SKF-B — SKF | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Healthy moderately sloped uptrend with an L2H2 pattern and strong year-end seasonality.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe likes the non-parabolic trend slope, says the momentum ('G-forces') is in place and the medium-term higher-lows/higher-highs structure is intact, and notes year-end seasonality is usually strong. The caveat is that a Swedish market crash would drag everything down.

#### Sell Triggers

- broad Swedish market collapse
- trend structure breaks

> *"Väldigt, väldigt goda förutsättningar tycker jag. för att aktien ska dra vidare uppåt."*

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Rounded bottom and flag. Enter on a positive candle with a stop below the last two days' lows.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe calls the setup very exciting: volume balance and the trend indicator are positive and stochastics sit at the zero zone. The pullback must not break Fib50 at 53 SEK or the MA200.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below Fib50 at 53 SEK
- break below MA200

> *"Det här ser ju riktigt, riktigt spännande ut måste jag säga."*
